title: Abased Souls
description: Lightweight PvP pack with clean visuals and real FPS performance.
body:
If you’re into Minecraft PvP and want something that looks clean, runs smooth, and actually helps your performance, Abased Souls is built for that. It keeps visuals sharp but lightweight, giving you a real FPS boost while cutting down screen clutter, so you can stay focused and react faster in fights. Unlike a lot of overrated packs that just stack effects and kill your FPS, this one keeps things simple where it matters and smooth where it counts.

---

## Previews

Here are some previews of the armor, weapons, and blocks included in the pack:

![Potions, Minerals, Armors, Tools, and Weapons](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ef094b24b6959b3da2a3c7b8b27def2a3ae4930d.png)

*This image shows the custom items in the pack, including redesigned armor sets, weapons, tools, potions, and minerals. The textures are cleaner and less bulky, making them easier to see and use during PvP without blocking your view.*

![Blocks: Wool, Stone, Granite, Polished Granite, Diorite, Polished Diorite, Andesite, Polished Andesite, Grass Block, Dirt](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f1d506a775210a1743cf559295c566775c1582df.png)

*This image shows updated block textures like wool, stone variants, grass, and dirt. The style is simplified and more consistent, helping improve visibility while keeping the game looking clean and smooth.*
